description:
About the Position

This PhD develops methods for locating electromagnetic interference and stray currents in complex electrical systems. Dairy-farm measurements provide a practical application for studying sources and propagation paths.

Research Position Overview

Create synchronised multi-node measurements of currents, voltages and fields. Combine signal processing with analysis across time, frequency, space and impedance to evaluate targeted mitigation.

Research Areas

  • Electromagnetic compatibility
  • Stray-current sensing
  • Digital signal processing
